text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And here we are!
The second leg of the Tiara road!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Which Umamusume will become this year's heroine?!
Let us bear witness as they bloom upon the stage of oaks!

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text: "Still, this year's Tiara route certainly took us by surprise with those unexpected turns, didn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text: With Vodka out of the picture, is she entirely unchallenged now? Or will another front-runner leap into the spotlight—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...As planned, I ran in the Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
And just as planned, I will take first place in this race.
Only then will everyone finally acknowledge me.
choice_data_list: Don't put too much pressure on yourself.
Don't put too much pressure on yourself, okay?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...No need to worry.
I'm just going to run like I always do.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Even in this race without her...!
